I received this grill prior to Memorial Day weekend, to my surprise, shipping was incredibly fast. The 2 heavy large boxes were tediously well packed, with easy to follow instructions. 2 hours of assembly, another hour of testing, first burn off, and pre-seasoning of the grills themselves, and the Denali 605 pro was up and running. First My first grill consisted of Lobster tails, skewered shrimp, and grille asparagus for which the reversible griddle I ordered came in changing for me. This has to be the best bang for your hard earned dollar available.
